title: Sapient
summary: Self-custody wallet for Tari Ootle. The Chrome Web Store review on November 17 recorded extension 0.10.0 and creator-confirmed mainnet/testnet switching. Separately, the creator published Android 0.10.1 on November 18 for Android 10 or newer: release notes announce NFT viewing, sending and receiving, token privacy actions, and a fix for WalletConnect requests received while locked. These are creator release claims. This review read the release notes without acquiring or installing an APK, connecting a wallet or transacting. The new recording shows the Android release announcement; it does not demonstrate the application. The Android version does not replace the recorded Chrome extension version.
cardSummary: Manage Ootle accounts with Sapient’s browser wallet, or explore its Android release with NFT and token tools.
